label: Screen Cloud
description: Real product screens floating at depth in a soft field, the camera drifting through them with a real depth of field (near and far screens soft, the one in focus crisp), and focus pulls from screen to screen on the words. Screens are images (captures, screenshots); screen 0 is the hero in the middle. With no screens it draws UI mock screens in the accent color. three.js; deterministic under seek.

screens.label: Screens: image URLs, or { src, aspect (w/h, default 1.6), size (default 1) }. Screen 0 is the hero.

focus.label: Focus pulls: { at (seconds or "@word"), screen (index) }. Starts on screen 0.

count.label: Number of screens when none are given (mocks), max 16

enter_at.label: When the screens fade up (seconds or "@word")

seed.label: Layout seed (vary for a different arrangement)
